question: Among tumor-intrinsic perturbations represented in both datasets, do gene-level directions of CTL-vs-control differential selection across the six Lawson mouse tumor lines agree with anti-CD19-vs-control anti-hEGFRvIII CAR-T selection in the measured murine B-ALL validation panel, separated by the actual in-vitro E:T and in-vivo organ/dose contrasts?
importance: Potentially relevant to selecting tumor-intrinsic resistance mechanisms for CAR-T prioritization; could distinguish CTL-screen results from CAR-T-specific results if a named mechanism and fair contrast survive.
exact_increment: The fixed descriptive test found five primary CTL-sensitizing/Ramos-resistant flags and zero symmetric flags. Med16 is already reported in Lawson and Irf1 is a known IFN context pattern; the other three non-IFN flags remain unresolved. No mechanism or project-level increment is established.
data_gate: PASS for bounded descriptive feasibility: corrected count-column mapping, frozen filters, six mapped CTL contexts, and exact-symbol join; 847/1,021 panel genes matched. Source-defined endpoint/control days are sometimes unequal.
novelty_gate: UNRESOLVED: five primary flags; Med16 was already reported as an in-vivo EMT6 sensitizer and Irf1 is known IFN biology. Nprl3, Cbfa2t3, and Etv5 are unresolved pending bounded targeted review. Zero symmetric flags; no novelty claim.
evaluation_gate: PARTIAL: the fixed descriptive comparison was computationally evaluable and independently recomputed; this is not causal attribution or independent replication. Six CTL tumor lines versus one B-ALL CAR-T model, selected panel, and timing/background/antigen differences constrain interpretation.
unit: Six Lawson tumor-line models for CTL context; one murine B-ALL model with selected validation genes for CAR-T. Nine culture-pair values per eligible gene/context are descriptive; they are not independent models.
comparator: Lawson: CTL vs paired controls; untreated except B16-Ova/MC38-Ova WT-CD8 controls. CAR-T: anti-CD19 vs anti-hEGFRvIII. In vitro E:T 1:2/1:10; in-vivo SP/BM comparisons with 10m/15m dose mismatch in some headers.
next_decisive_test: Complete the bounded targeted prior-art review of the exact non-IFN flags. Parent decides whether any distinct, biologically substantial question merits a separate plan; otherwise close C01. No additional search/data/model fitting in this stage.
verdict: NO PASS for project selection at present; retain only as unresolved near-miss pending targeted review. Five exploratory flags are not a new mechanism.
